methodology: Use the latest archived snapshot on each recorded date, with no interpolation.
Points are cumulative roto standings points, not player fantasy production or points scored within a week. Changes measure movement in the standings.
Seven-day changes compare exact calendar-date endpoints, not seven rows. Intervening missing dates do not invalidate a measured endpoint change.
Daily movements compare exactly adjacent calendar dates; Apr14→Apr16 is excluded.
Months compare the last snapshot of the previous month to month end; September ends Sep27. March is only a partial opening sample and is excluded from monthly awards.
Displayed ranks are archived order, including arbitrary or externally defined ordering among equal point totals. Do not infer a tiebreak rule.
Days-in-first and top-three counts mean observed daily snapshots. They exclude missing Apr15 and do not measure intraday time.
A personal highlight is a supported team milestone, not an assertion of unique league superiority.
Least lineup changes cannot be determined from standings snapshots. Requires separate lineup-history coverage and a definition of change.
caveats: Final snapshot has Seam heads and Rollie Fingers tied at 98 points, with archived displayed ranks 2 and 3. Also Millville Meteors and Sam tie at 44 points, displayed ranks 8 and 9. Preserve display order without inventing a tiebreak explanation.
Beginning Mar27 may exclude an earlier real opening-day result if the archive starts late; phrase start-to-finish using the archive date range.
Large early-season point changes reflect volatile cumulative category standings.

balanced_awards.title: From Tenth to the Throne
balanced_awards.description: Started 10th. Finished champion. The league’s biggest start-to-finish climb ended with 111 points.
balanced_awards.method: Last snapshot minus first snapshot; +64 points and 9 displayed places, both outright league records.

balanced_awards.title: The Pace Setter
balanced_awards.description: More recorded days at No. 1 than anyone else—and a podium spot on 183 of 184 recorded dates.
balanced_awards.method: Count archived displayed rank 1 and rank <=3. Missing Apr15 is not counted.

balanced_awards.title: Steady on the Podium
balanced_awards.description: The league’s steadiest displayed rank, with a top-three spot on 176 recorded dates.
balanced_awards.method: Lowest population standard deviation of archived displayed ranks over 184 dates: 0.7623432933. Podium count itself is second-highest.

balanced_awards.title: April Belonged to Philbell
balanced_awards.description: Nobody gained more standings points in April. June belonged to Philbell, too: another league-best +11.
balanced_awards.method: Month-end points minus previous month-end points: Mar31→Apr30 and May31→Jun30.

balanced_awards.title: The Long Climb
balanced_awards.description: From 12th in early April to a fifth-place finish, recovering 31.5 points from the season low.
balanced_awards.method: Worst archived rank was 12; minimum points 42.5; final rank 5 and points 74. Personal recovery; not claimed as the largest in the league.

balanced_awards.title: Seven-Day Surge
balanced_awards.description: The season’s biggest seven-day points gain: 11th to fifth in one week.
balanced_awards.method: Compare pairs of snapshots exactly 7 calendar days apart. Mar30 42.5 points, rank11 → Apr6 71.5 points, rank5.

balanced_awards.title: The Express Elevator
balanced_awards.description: Tenth to third in seven days—tied with Trazadone for the season’s biggest one-week rank climb.
balanced_awards.method: Maximum displayed-rank improvement between dates exactly 7 calendar days apart. Both winners gain 7 places.

balanced_awards.title: Meteoric Rise
balanced_awards.description: Eleventh to third in a day. A 31-point burst delivered the biggest daily leap in both points and places.
balanced_awards.method: Compare consecutive calendar-date snapshots. Mar27 46.5 points, rank11 → Mar28 77.5 points, rank3.

balanced_awards.title: May Magic
balanced_awards.description: A 17.5-point burst from May 14–21 was Sam’s best week of the season.
balanced_awards.method: Maximum personal points improvement between dates exactly 7 calendar days apart; not presented as the full-season league record.

balanced_awards.title: The Scenic Route
balanced_awards.description: The busiest line on the atlas: 68 places of daily movement, plus a shared record seven-place weekly climb.
balanced_awards.method: Sum absolute displayed-rank changes between consecutive calendar dates. Excludes Apr14→Apr16 because Apr15 is missing. 49 rank-changing daily intervals, also league-high.

balanced_awards.title: The September Spark
balanced_awards.description: The league’s biggest September points gain belonged to Jonesin’. Strong all the way to the finish.
balanced_awards.method: Sep27 standings points minus Aug31 standings points. September is measured only through the requested Sep27 cutoff.

balanced_awards.title: Summer Revival
balanced_awards.description: June, July, and August all finished in the black: a seven-point summer recovery, including +5 in August.
balanced_awards.method: Points increased +1.5 in June, +0.5 in July, +5 in August, comparing month-end snapshots. Personal milestone; not a unique league record.

extra_awards.title: The Closing Argument
extra_awards.description: Led every recorded date from August 6 through September 27.
extra_awards.method: Longest contiguous calendar-date streak at displayed rank 1; missing dates break streaks.

extra_awards.title: Peak of the Season
extra_awards.description: The highest points total recorded by any team all season.
extra_awards.method: Maximum points across all team-date snapshots.

extra_awards.title: Every Month Up
extra_awards.description: Added standings points in each full month from April through August.
extra_awards.method: Month-end point changes Apr +6.5, May +4, Jun +2, Jul +13.5, Aug +8. September through Sep27 was flat.

extra_awards.title: Podium Permanent Resident
extra_awards.description: Finished a recorded day outside the top three only once.
extra_awards.method: Maximum count of archived displayed rank <=3; these are recorded dates, not complete calendar coverage.

extra_awards.title: June Bloom
extra_awards.description: The league’s largest June standings-points gain.

extra_awards.title: July Takeoff
extra_awards.description: The league’s largest July standings-points gain.

extra_awards.title: May Momentum
extra_awards.description: The league’s largest May standings-points gain.

extra_awards.title: Seven Rungs in Seven Days
extra_awards.description: Matched John Henry Fan Club’s seven-place weekly climb, with a 24-point gain.
extra_awards.method: Maximum displayed-rank improvement between exact seven-calendar-day endpoints.

extra_awards.title: August Accelerator
extra_awards.description: The league’s largest August standings-points gain.

extra_awards.title: August Upswing
extra_awards.description: The second-biggest August points gain in the league.
extra_awards.method: Aug31 points minus Jul31 points; +5 ranks second behind Humongous Melonheads +8.

methodology: Lineup submissions are distinct executed Fantrax lineup-change groups. One submission can contain several player-slot changes.
Player changes count the individual player-slot rows contained in those executed submissions.
Adds, drops, and trades are separate executed Fantrax transaction-history views.
All figures use March 27 through September 27, matching the standings animation.

awards.title: The Daily Tinkerer
awards.description: Nobody moved more players between lineup slots. Those moves came in 1,502 executed lineup submissions, also the league high.

awards.title: The Lineup Minimalist
awards.description: The fewest individual player-slot changes in the league, across 135 executed lineup submissions.

awards.title: Set It and Let It Ride
awards.description: The fewest executed lineup submissions in the league—one fewer than Millville Meteors.

awards.title: Waiver Wire Workhorse
awards.description: The busiest waiver desk: 130 adds and 132 drops across the season window.

awards.title: Waiver Wire Minimalist
awards.description: The league’s lightest touch on the player pool: 22 adds and 11 drops.

awards.title: The Deal Maker
awards.description: The most trades in the league, with 22 players sent and 22 received.

awards.title: The Position Puzzle
awards.description: The most same-status position changes—moves between active slots without an Active, Reserve, Minors, or Injured Reserve change.

awards.title: The Consolidator
awards.description: No team sent away more players than it received across its completed trades.

awards.title: Injury-Room Traffic Controller
awards.description: The most player moves into or out of Injured Reserve during the season window.
